description: Resolve git conflict markers in package-lock.json or a YAML lockfile — Takes a lockfile (package-lock.json or a YAML lockfile such as pnpm-lock.yaml) containing git merge-conflict markers, rebuilds both sides, and merges them key by key (using the diff3 base when present), returning the resolved file or the exact conflicting key paths with both values, for agents rebasing or merging branches. An optional prefer=ours|theirs applies one explicit policy to the remaining

content.description: Whole file text; YAML at most 100000 characters.

format.description: Default auto: JSON when the file starts with { or [.

prefer.description: Policy for keys changed on both sides. Default none: report them.

name: lockfile-merge
